newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Weaker banks take Swedish stocks lower at close.
newsitem.headline: Weaker banks take Swedish stocks lower at close.

text.p: Swedish stocks rallied towards the close on Tuesday after bobbing above and below the par for most of the day, unable to drive forward on an unexpectedly large cut in the key Riksbank repo rate.
"It felt right from the start there was no strength in the bourse," said one broker.
The banking and insurance sector fell 1.6 percent, with Skandia down eight at 189 and Stadshypotek down eight at 195 among the most widely traded after Monday's proposed merger.
Skandia's share was trading at 198 last Wednesday when the first rumours of a possible bid for Stadshypotek surfaced.
Analysts believe it is doubtful whether the two companies would indeed realise synergies of 1.2 billion crowns as they advertised in the proposed merger.
Astra began strongly in the wake of a pharmaceuticals rally in the U.S. but then fell on generalised profit-taking to close 2.50 down after hitting a peak of 322.50.
Pharmacia & Upjohn held onto part of its early day gains to close four up at 253.
Bluechip telecoms giant Ericsson was four crowns lower at 204 crowns.
